SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(customers.credit) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.credit_sum"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _base."orders.revenue",
  _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum."customers.credit_sum" AS "orders.credit_total"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum."customers.regions.name"
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: Revenue is the sum of order amounts, grouped by the region of each order's customer. Credit total is the sum of credit limits over every customer in that region, so customers who never ordered are counted too. Orders whose customer has no known region are in the null row.
